gloss: crucial moment to persevere; time to hang in there

definitions.gloss: crucial moment to persevere; time to stand firm
definitions.explanation: A critical point where one must endure hardship or exert maximum effort. Implies that giving up now would waste previous effort, so one should push through.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}りどころだ。
examples.english: This is the moment to hang in there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}りどころだ。
examples.english: The week before the exam is the crucial time to push through.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちている→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}りどころだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{語|かた}った→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: The president told the employees that now, when sales are declining, is the time to persevere.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used with ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ or ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ to mark the present moment as the critical time to endure. Common in sports, business, and exam preparation contexts. Carries a strong motivational tone.

FORMS:
⟦{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}る→踏ん張る：05539_funbaru⟧ (to brace oneself, to stand firm) + どころ (place/time for doing something).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}りどころ (this is the time to stand firm)
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}りどころ (now is the time to persevere)
- ⟦{正念場|しょうねんば}→正念場：13193_shounenba⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}りどころ (critical juncture and time to endure)
